metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over Nassau County, New York lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) concentration over Nassau County, New York, comparing October 1-23, 2021 with the same period in 2019 and 2018. 1. **Search strategy**: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data for NO2 measurements - Collection: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2' - Band: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' - Location: Nassau County, New York (need to define polygon) - Dates: Oct 1-23 for 2018, 2019, and 2021 2. **Masking strategy**: - NO2 data typically has quality flags, but for simplicity I'll use the standard tropospheric NO2 column - Will check for valid pixel counts 3. **Logic**: - Get mean NO2 for each period - Compare 2021 mean with both 2018 and 2019 - If 2021 < 2018 AND 2021 < 2019 → A (Yes) - Else → B (No) - Handle cases C1-C3 as needed Let me define the geometry for Nassau County, NY approximately. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Nassau County, NY geometry (approximate bounds) const nassauCounty = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-73.70, 40.85], [-73.45, 40.85], [-73.45, 40.63], [-73.70, 40.63], [-73.70, 40.85] ]); // Function to get NO2 data for a given year function getNO2Data(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 10, 1); const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 10, 23); const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterBounds(nassauCounty) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); return collection; } // Get collections for each year const col2018 = getNO2Data(2018); const col2019 = getNO2Data(2019); const col2021 = getNO2Data(2021); // Check collection sizes const size2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); const size2021 = col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 Images: ${size2018}, 2019 Images: ${size2019}, 2021 Images: ${size2021}`); // Check for empty collections if (size2018 === 0 || size2019 === 0 || size2021 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 for each period function calculateMean(collection) { const meanImage = collection.mean(); const stats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: nassauCounty, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return stats.getInfo(); } const stats2018 = calculateMean(col2018); const stats2019 = calculateMean(col2019); const stats2021 = calculateMean(col2021); const mean2018 = stats2018['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density']; const mean2019 = stats2019['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density']; const mean2021 = stats2021['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density']; const count2018 = stats2018['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; const count2019 = stats2019['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; const count2021 = stats2021['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; console.log(`2018: ${mean2018?.toFixed(6) || 'No data'} (Pixels: ${count2018})`); console.log(`2019: ${mean2019?.toFixed(6) || 'No data'} (Pixels: ${count2019})`); console.log(`2021: ${mean2021?.toFixed(6) || 'No data'} (Pixels: ${count2021})`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count2018 === 0 || count2019 === 0 || count2021 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (mean2018 === null || mean2019 === null || mean2021 === null || isNaN(mean2018) || isNaN(mean2019) || isNaN(mean2021)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Validate NO2 values are in reasonable range (molec/cm²) if (mean2018 < 0 || mean2019 < 0 || mean2021 < 0 || mean2018 > 1e17 || mean2019 > 1e17 || mean2021 > 1e17) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare values - check if 2021 is lower than both 2018 and 2019 const isLowerThan2018 = mean2021 < mean2018; const isLowerThan2019 = mean2021 < mean2019; console.log(`2021 < 2018: ${isLowerThan2018}, 2021 < 2019: ${isLowerThan2019}`); if (isLowerThan2018 && isLowerThan2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
